title: Document CUJ-state testing methodology architecture for Vaporize
createdBy: codex after operator requested engineering documentation for the testing methodology

historicalContent.sourceLocation: Codex session 2026-06-26: operator asked for an essay and engineering documentation on the architecture of this testing methodology.
historicalContent.description: Add package-local engineering documentation explaining CUJ-state testing methodology: why Vaporize starts from critical user journeys, how CUJ state is materialized, how receipts and focused tests prove the slice, and where Kura/database concerns belong.
